title: Admissibility and scalar preservation for listed coefficient presentations
statement: Let ell be prime and a : Λ → Λ' satisfy ListedCoefficientMap ell a, with the exact coefficient presentations and sectionwise map normalizations of def-sfb-listed-coefficient-maps. Both Λ and Λ' satisfy IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ell. For every positive-characteristic field k of characteristic different from ell and every separated finite-type k-scheme X, the actual ordinary unbounded derived extension scalarSixChange a X sends bounded constant-model constructible complexes of finite Tor amplitude to complexes with these same two properties.

proof.text: For each primitive listed map identify its endpoint ring objects with the corresponding admissible continuous-function objects. For finite rings use a Type 0 finite ring isomorphic to the given Type u ring, with the discrete topology. Constant-to-continuous finite comparison and postcomposition identify the prescribed map, including the zero ring. The equalities in the integral, field, localization and algebraic-closure constructors identify the remaining maps. The endpoint isomorphisms prove the disjunctions defining admissibility.

For each nonidentity primitive use scalarSixCtf clause (3) after the preceding change of presentation. Exact scalar equivalences preserve finite constant presentations, bounds and Tor tests: for Tor amplitude transport an arbitrary test sheaf through the inverse equivalence and use its monoidal tensor comparison. The algebraic-closure identity acts through the scalar unit isomorphism and preserves all these predicates.

Induct on finite composites. The induction hypotheses retain the two outer endpoint assertions and send a finite-Tor bounded constructible input successively to two objects of the same kind. The canonical scalarSixTower associator identifies this composite with extension along the composite map. Transport both predicates along that isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem listedCoefficientCtf (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {Λ Λ' : ScalarSixRing.{u}} (a : Λ ⟶ Λ') (ha : ListedCoefficientMap ell a) :
    IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ell Λ.X ∧
    IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ell Λ'.X ∧
    (∀ (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ell)]
      (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
      [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
      (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X X.left)),
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ.X X.left K ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ K) →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ'.X X.left ((scalarSixChange a X.left).obj K) ∧
        DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ ((scalarSixChange a X.left).obj K))
